sentences.cn: 我讨厌你没完没了的抱怨。
sentences.cn_source: 我讨厌你没完没了的抱怨。

sentences.c: To his everlasting credit , he never told anyone what I'd done.
sentences.cn: 值得永远称赞的是他从未把我做的事告诉过任何人。
sentences.cn_source: 值得永远称赞的是他从未把我做的事告诉过任何人。

phrases.cn: 开天辟地以来，自古以来

trans.cn: Thường trực, vĩnh viễn; (đặc biệt là một vấn đề hoặc khó khăn) tái diễn, luôn hiện hữu; (nhân viên) trọn đời, lâu dài; (địa chỉ nhà) cố định
trans.cn_source: 永久的，永恒的；（尤指问题或困难）不断出现的，一直存在的；（员工）终生的，长期的；（家庭住址）固定的

trans.cn: <Làm đẹp>Perm
trans.cn_source: <美>烫发

sentences.c: The accident has not done any permanent damage.
sentences.cn: 那场事故没有造成什么永久性损伤。
sentences.cn_source: 那场事故没有造成什么永久性损伤。

sentences.c: She has been granted permanent residency in Britain.
sentences.cn: 她获准在英国永久居住。
sentences.cn_source: 她获准在英国永久居住。

sentences.c: Heavy drinking can cause permanent damage to the brain.
sentences.cn: 饮酒过量可能造成永久性脑损伤。
sentences.cn_source: 饮酒过量可能造成永久性脑损伤。

trans.cn: Đúng giờ, đúng giờ; <cũ> chính xác; (ngữ pháp) (hành động) nhất thời
trans.cn_source: 准时的，守时的；<旧>精确的；（语法）（动作）瞬息性的

sentences.c: She has been reliable and punctual.
sentences.cn: 她一直可靠守时。
sentences.cn_source: 她一直可靠守时。

sentences.c: He's always very punctual. I'll see if he's here yet.
sentences.cn: 他一向很准时。我要看看他是不是已经来了。
sentences.cn_source: 他一向很准时。我要看看他是不是已经来了。

sentences.c: A man who gets up at seven o'clock every morning is punctual.
sentences.cn: 每天早上七点起床的人是守时的。
sentences.cn_source: 每天早上七点起床的人是守时的。

trans.cn: thời lượng, thời lượng
trans.cn_source: 持续，持续时间

sentences.c: The duration of previous geologic periods was difficult to determine.
sentences.cn: 以前很难确定地质期的持续时间。
sentences.cn_source: 以前很难确定地质期的持续时间。

sentences.c: They were incarcerated for the duration of the war.
sentences.cn: 他们在战争期间被监禁。
sentences.cn_source: 他们在战争期间被监禁。

sentences.c: His wounds knocked him out of combat for the duration.
sentences.cn: 在整个战斗中，他的伤一直令他无法参战。
sentences.cn_source: 在整个战斗中，他的伤一直令他无法参战。

trans.cn: liên tục, không bị gián đoạn
trans.cn_source: 连续的，不间断的

sentences.c: The Cup was won for the third consecutive year by the Toronto Maple Leafs.
sentences.cn: 这个奖杯连续第三年由多伦多枫叶队赢去了。
sentences.cn_source: 这个奖杯连续第三年由多伦多枫叶队赢去了。

sentences.c: The manufacturing economy contracted in October for the sixth consecutive month.
sentences.cn: 制造业经济到10月份已连续萎缩6个月了。
sentences.cn_source: 制造业经济到10月份已连续萎缩6个月了。

sentences.c: In Ontario, August was the first month with below-normal temperatures after eight consecutive months above normal.
sentences.cn: 在安大略省，8月份是连续8个月高于正常温度之后的第一个低于正常温度的月份。
sentences.cn_source: 在安大略省，8月份是连续8个月高于正常温度之后的第一个低于正常温度的月份。

trans.cn: thường xuyên, định kỳ; thỉnh thoảng, không liên tục
trans.cn_source: 定期地，周期性地；偶尔，间歇

sentences.c: Mailing lists are updated periodically.
sentences.cn: 邮寄名单定期更新。
sentences.cn_source: 邮寄名单定期更新。

sentences.c: Meetings are held periodically to monitor progress on the case.
sentences.cn: 定期召开会议监控案件的进展情况。
sentences.cn_source: 定期召开会议监控案件的进展情况。

sentences.c: Periodically, starfish population explodes.
sentences.cn: 海星的数量会周期性地激增。
sentences.cn_source: 海星的数量会周期性地激增。

trans.cn: Điều gì sắp xảy ra, điều gì đang đến gần; <cổ> treo
trans.cn_source: 即将发生的，临近的；<古>垂悬的

sentences.c: Every one feels that a disaster is imminent, as if a catastrophe is about to come.
sentences.cn: 谁都感到大事不好，似乎有什么极大的灾难即将来临。
sentences.cn_source: 谁都感到大事不好，似乎有什么极大的灾难即将来临。

sentences.c: There's been a warning about the imminent death of literate civilization for a long time.
sentences.cn: 很长一段时间以来，一直有关于文化文明即将死亡的警告。
sentences.cn_source: 很长一段时间以来，一直有关于文化文明即将死亡的警告。

sentences.c: Some rickshaw pullers I met were resigned to the imminent end of their livelihood and pin their hopes on being offered something in its place.
sentences.cn: 我见过一些车夫，他们已经对他们的生活即将走到穷途末路的情形逆来顺受，寄希望于能有什么东西来代替他们。
sentences.cn_source: 我见过一些车夫，他们已经对他们的生活即将走到穷途末路的情形逆来顺受，寄希望于能有什么东西来代替他们。

phrases.cn: 紧迫的威胁；逼近的威胁

trans.cn: Nhân tiện; tình cờ ; tình cờ, kèm theo
trans.cn_source: 顺便说一句；偶然地；附带地，伴随地

sentences.c: Incidentally, have you heard the news about Sue?
sentences.cn: 顺便问一句，你听说过休的事了吗？
sentences.cn_source: 顺便问一句，你听说过休的事了吗？

sentences.c: The information was only discovered incidentally.
sentences.cn: 这个信息只是偶然得到的。
sentences.cn_source: 这个信息只是偶然得到的。

sentences.c: "I didn't ask you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?"
sentences.cn: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么来呢？”
sentences.cn_source: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么来呢？”
